verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's webhook docs cover both halves of the story. Every webhook carries a `webhook-id` header that the docs tell developers to use as an idempotency key for deduplicating retries. The same docs describe webhook signing for authenticity, opt-in per account. Missing for 10: details on the signature scheme and verification procedure (algorithm, headers, timestamp/replay protection), documentation of retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
